notes.title: Major Update Preparation Phase 2
notes.notes:
Fixed issue with music stuttering upon switching songs.
Fixed issue with bullets providing massive knockback.
Fixed enemy weight issue.

Added ability to choose enemies in arena, and special modifiers.
Changed XP requirements for leveling up.
Armors now change texture on cubes.
